footnotes.text: “Jesus is the Sun. To any who may be struggling to see that light and find that hope, I say: Hold on. Keep trying. God loves you. Things will improve. Christ comes to you in His ‘more excellent ministry’ with a future of ‘better promises’ [Hebrews 8:6]. He is your ‘high priest of good things to come’ [Hebrews 9:11]” (Jeffrey R. Holland, “An High Priest of Good Things to Come,”Ensign, Nov. 1999, 36;Liahona, Jan. 2000, 42).
